RPC simulation: mismatched market rejected (Custom 5); owner-not-signer rejected (Custom 12); own-market baseline passes gates

main vs aux .text differ 1492/566888 bytes (0.26%), constants only; check region byte-identical
available liquidity main $1,170,428 + aux $100,952 = $1,271,380; all 20 reserves >=$100 refreshable (H-O)

one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0 from Larix: the deployed SetConfig path enforces market-owner signature and the reserve<->market binding (2021 Solend check present), so the unpatched-config-update hypothesis is refuted; $1.27M of reserve liquidity is holder-redeemable (H-O).
